賓主盡歡.d: 主人和客人都非常盡興。

s.y: Thank you for your warm hospitality.

s.z: 很高興看到這麼多朋友歡聚一堂。

e: a good time was had by all

不虛此行.d: 沒有白走這一趟，很有收穫。

a.z: 找她的鑰匙感覺是徒勞無功。

不虛此行.u: 多用於旅行、參訪、會議之後。

滿載而歸.d: 裝得滿滿地回來；形容收穫豐富。
x: 希望大家都能從這場論壇滿載而歸。

e: come away with a great deal

滿載而歸.u: 多用於旅行、學習、比賽、購物。

天下無不散的筵席.d: 再盛大的宴席也有散的時候；比喻相聚終須分別。

s.y: Thank you, and until we meet again.
Take care, and goodbye for now.

a.z: 很高興看到這麼多朋友歡聚一堂。
a.y: It is a pleasure to see so many friends gathered together.

e: all good things must come to an end
天下無不散的筵席.u: 口語；多用於送別、閉幕，帶點感傷或豁達。

來日方長.d: 未來的日子還很長，以後還有機會。
x: 來日方長，以後還有很多合作機會。

s.y: Thank you, and until we meet again.
Hang in there: better days ahead.

a.z: 今天就報名，時間不等人。
a.y: Sign up today. You snooze, you lose.

a.z: 事不宜遲，快打電話給醫生。
a.y: There's no time to lose, so call the doctor.

e: there will be many more opportunities ahead
we have all the time in the world
來日方長.u: 多用於安慰、送別，表示不必急於一時。

功德圓滿.d: 原為佛教語，指修行功德圓滿；今多指事情圓滿完成。
x: 隨著這場典禮，三年的計畫功德圓滿。

s.y: We wish the conference a complete success.

e: waiting for the dust to settle
s.z: 等塵埃落定再做決定吧。
s.y: Let's wait for the dust to settle before we make any decision.

e: all one's efforts go down the drain
a.z: 一個錯誤就可能讓前功盡棄。
a.y: One mistake could undo all the hard work.

功德圓滿.u: 原為佛教用語；今也用於計畫、活動結束，有時帶調侃。

x: 我們期待與各位共創未來。

s.y: Let us move forward hand in hand.

a.y: After the project, the partners decided to part ways.

共創未來.u: 多用於致詞、合作簽約、願景宣言。

後會有期.d: 以後還有見面的機會；用於告別。

s.y: Take care, and goodbye for now.

s.y: Thank you, and until we meet again.
Have a safe trip home.

s.y: Congratulations to the team, and keep up the good work.

s.y: He strove upward and finally got into the school he wanted.

a.y: For him, this is a piece of cake.

e: the road ahead is long and the responsibility heavy

e: the road ahead is long and the responsibility heavy

s.y: Take care, and goodbye for now.
